definition_en: to remove a covering or clothing, to take something away from someone, or a long narrow piece
core_image: 一层外皮被从上往下撕开，露出里面的东西
scene: 他脱掉湿衣服。He stripped off his wet clothes.
sceneCN: 这里 strip 是「脱去」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他脱掉湿衣服。

senses.title: Remove a covering
senses.definition: to take off clothes or a covering
senses.definitionCN: 脱去衣服或去掉覆盖物
senses.example: He stripped off his wet clothes.
senses.exampleCN: 他脱掉湿衣服。
senses.why: This is the physical removal.
senses.whyCN: 这是身体上的去除。

senses.title: Take something away
senses.definition: to take away power, rights, or possessions
senses.definitionCN: 夺走权力、权利或财物
senses.example: The court stripped him of his title.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭剥夺了他的头衔。
senses.why: Rights can be peeled away like clothes.
senses.whyCN: 权利也能像衣服一样被剥掉。

senses.title: A narrow piece
senses.definition: a long narrow piece of something
senses.definitionCN: 又长又窄的一块东西
senses.example: A strip of land runs along the river.
senses.exampleCN: 一条狭长的土地沿河延伸。
senses.why: A peeled layer can become a band.
senses.whyCN: 被剥下的一层，可以成为一条带子。

intro.en: Strip comes from Middle English strippen, to remove clothing.
intro.cn: strip 来自中古英语 strippen，意为脱去衣物。

items.en: A related word meant to plunder.
items.cn: 相关词表示掠夺。

items.en: Strippen meant to take off clothes.
items.cn: strippen 意为脱掉衣服。

items.en: Strip also meant to remove a layer.
items.cn: strip 也表示去掉一层。

items.en: It came to mean taking away rights.
items.cn: 它开始表示剥夺权利。

items.en: A strip became a long narrow piece.
items.cn: a strip 指一条狭长之物。

note.en: Strip is compared with look-alike words and with words for removing.
note.cn: 把 strip 与形近词以及表示去除的词作比较。

entries.definition: a long narrow band of colour
to remove the skin of fruit

normalIntro.en: Strip is a layer coming off, and what is left when it does.
normalIntro.cn: strip 是一层被去掉，也是去掉之后剩下的东西。

normal.en: He stripped the old paint off.
They stripped him of his rank.
A narrow strip of grass lined the road.
normal.cn: 路边有一条窄窄的草地。

normal.en: She read the comic strip in the paper.
normal.cn: 她读报纸上的连环漫画。

normal.en: The engine was stripped down for repair.

abstract.en: To strip is to find out what is underneath.
abstract.cn: 剥去，就是看看下面还有什么。

abstract.en: What is stripped away can be put back.
abstract.cn: 被剥掉的东西，还能装回去。

abstract.en: A thin strip is enough to mark a border.
abstract.cn: 窄窄一条，就足以标出边界。

examples.en: He stripped off his wet clothes.
examples.cn: 他脱掉湿衣服。

examples.en: The court stripped him of his title.
examples.cn: 法庭剥夺了他的头衔。

examples.en: A strip of land runs along the river.
examples.cn: 一条狭长的土地沿河延伸。

dict_mnemonic.text: strip 的核心是「去掉外层」；脱衣是脱去，剥漆是剥去，夺走头衔是剥夺，而剥下来的一条就是条带。

root: 来自中古英语 strippen（脱衣），与日耳曼语相关词同源；由去掉衣物与覆盖层，引申为剥夺权利，再由剥下的一层引申为条状物。

sensesIntro.en: Strip removes clothes or layers, takes away what someone has, or names a narrow band.
sensesIntro.cn: strip 去掉衣服或外层，夺走某人拥有的东西，也指一条窄带。

core.en: A layer peeled back from the top.
core.cn: 一层东西从顶部被剥开。

branches.en: Wet clothes fall to the floor.
branches.cn: 湿衣服落到地上。

branches.en: A title is taken away.
branches.cn: 一个头衔被拿走。

branches.en: A narrow field follows the river.
branches.cn: 一条窄田沿着河走。

branches.en: Clothes and honours can both be stripped.
branches.cn: 衣服与荣誉都可能被剥走。

branches.en: What is peeled off is itself a strip.
branches.cn: 被剥下来的东西，本身就是一条。

intro.en: Strip takes verb endings and builds adjective and noun forms.
intro.cn: strip 加动词词尾，并构成形容词与名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.meaning: a tool or person that strips

items.example: A strip of land divides the fields.
items.exampleCN: 一条狭长土地隔开两片田野。

definition_en: a sudden illness in the brain, a gentle movement of the hand, a single movement in swimming, or a single hit
core_image: 一只手顺着猫背轻轻滑过，动作平缓而连续
scene: 他轻轻抚摸猫的背。He stroked the cat's back gently.
sceneCN: 这里 stroke 是「抚摸」（第 2 个义项）；句意：他轻轻抚摸猫的背。

senses.title: A brain illness
senses.definition: a sudden illness caused by blood not reaching the brain
senses.definitionCN: 血液无法到达脑部引起的突发疾病
senses.example: Her grandfather had a stroke last year.
senses.exampleCN: 她祖父去年中风了。
senses.why: This is the medical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是医学上的义项。

senses.title: A gentle touch
senses.definition: a gentle movement of the hand over something
senses.definitionCN: 手在物体上轻柔地滑过
senses.example: He stroked the cat's back gently.
senses.exampleCN: 他轻轻抚摸猫的背。
senses.why: This is the hand moving smoothly.
senses.whyCN: 这是手平滑地移动。

senses.title: One movement
senses.definition: a single movement in swimming, rowing, or hitting
senses.definitionCN: 游泳、划桨或击打时的一个动作
senses.example: She swam fifty strokes across the pool.
senses.exampleCN: 她划了五十下横穿泳池。
senses.why: One sweep of the arm is one stroke.
senses.whyCN: 手臂扫过一次，就是一下。

intro.en: Stroke comes from Old English strac, a blow, and strican, to sweep.
intro.cn: stroke 来自古英语 strac（一击）与 strican（扫过）。

items.en: Strac named a blow or stroke.
items.cn: strac 指一击或一划。

items.en: The root named a quick sweeping movement.
items.cn: 这个词根表示快速扫过的动作。

items.en: Stroke meant a movement of the hand.
items.cn: 中古英语 stroke 指手的一次动作。

items.en: A stroke named one pull in rowing or swimming.
items.cn: stroke 指划船或游泳的一下。

items.en: The medical stroke described a sudden blow inside.
items.cn: 医学上的 stroke 描写体内突然的一击。

note.en: Stroke is compared with look-alike words and with words for touching.
note.cn: 把 stroke 与形近词以及表示触摸的词作比较。

entries.definition: to touch lightly with a flat hand

normalIntro.en: Stroke is one sweep of the hand, whether gentle or deadly.
normalIntro.cn: stroke 是手的一次扫过，可能温柔，也可能致命。

normal.en: She stroked the dog's head.
He suffered a stroke at work.
With one stroke, the problem was gone.
It was a stroke of luck.
The painter added a final stroke.

abstract.en: A gentle stroke can calm a wild heart.
abstract.cn: 轻轻一抚，能安抚一颗野性的心。

abstract.en: The same word holds a touch and a blow.
abstract.cn: 同一个词里，既有抚摸，也有重击。

abstract.en: One stroke of luck can change a whole year.
abstract.cn: 一次好运，能改变一整年。

examples.en: He stroked the cat's back gently.
examples.cn: 他轻轻抚摸猫的背。

examples.en: Her grandfather had a stroke last year.
examples.cn: 她祖父去年中风了。

examples.en: She swam fifty strokes across the pool.
examples.cn: 她划了五十下横穿泳池。

dict_mnemonic.text: stroke 本义是「一扫、一击」；手轻轻扫过是抚摸，手臂划一次是划水，体内突然一击是中风，运气突然来一下是 a stroke of luck。

root: 来自古英语 strac（一击）与 strican（扫过），属日耳曼语词；由一次扫过的动作，引申为抚摸、划水的一下、笔触，以及体内突发的病症。

sensesIntro.en: Stroke is a sudden illness, a soft sweep of the hand, or a single movement.
sensesIntro.cn: stroke 是一种突发疾病、手的一次轻抚，或一个单一的动作。

core.en: A hand passing once along a back.
core.cn: 一只手沿背部滑过一次。

branches.en: A patient loses speech suddenly.
branches.cn: 病人突然说不出话。

branches.en: A cat closes its eyes under a hand.
branches.cn: 猫在手下闭上眼睛。

branches.en: An arm pulls through water.
branches.cn: 手臂划过水面。

branches.en: One smooth movement can comfort or carry.
branches.cn: 一次平滑的动作，能安抚，也能带人前行。

branches.en: A sudden stroke can stop the body's own strokes.
branches.cn: 突然的中风，能让身体的划动停下。

intro.en: Stroke takes verb endings and builds action and compound nouns.
intro.cn: stroke 加动词词尾，并构成动作名词与复合名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: He had a stroke last winter.
The new law changed it at a stroke.
items.exampleCN: 新法律一下子改变了它。

items.example: Meeting her was a stroke of luck.

definition_en: having great physical power, great in degree or effect, or not easily broken
core_image: 一个人稳稳拉住绷紧的绳子，纹丝不动
scene: 他很强壮，能扛起那袋米。He is strong enough to carry the sack of rice.
sceneCN: 这里 strong 是「强壮的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他很强壮，能扛起那袋米。

senses.title: Physically powerful
senses.definition: having great physical power
senses.definitionCN: 身体力量很大的
senses.example: He is strong enough to carry the sack of rice.
senses.exampleCN: 他很强壮，能扛起那袋米。
senses.why: This is power in the body.
senses.whyCN: 这是身体里的力量。

senses.title: Great in degree
senses.definition: great in force, taste, or feeling
senses.definitionCN: 在力度、味道或情感上很强的
senses.example: A strong wind blew all night.
senses.exampleCN: 强风吹了一整夜。
senses.why: The idea of force spreads to wind and taste.
senses.whyCN: 力量的概念扩展到了风和味道。

senses.title: Hard to break
senses.definition: solid and not easily broken or damaged
senses.definitionCN: 结实而不易损坏的
senses.example: The bridge is strong enough for trucks.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥足够坚固，能承受卡车。
senses.why: A body's strength becomes a structure's.
senses.whyCN: 身体的强度变成了建筑的强度。

intro.en: Strong comes from Old English strang, powerful.
intro.cn: strong 来自古英语 strang，意为强大的。

items.en: Strang meant physically powerful.
items.cn: strang 意为身体强壮的。

items.en: The root also named tightness and severity.
items.cn: 这个词根也含有紧绷与严厉之意。

items.en: Strong kept the sense of power.
items.cn: 中古英语 strong 仍指力量。

items.en: Strong described wind, taste, and feelings.
items.cn: strong 开始形容风、味道与情感。

items.en: It also described solid structures.
items.cn: 它也用来形容坚固的结构。

note.en: Strong is compared with look-alike words and with words for power.
note.cn: 把 strong 与形近词以及表示强大的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Strong is power you can see in an arm, feel in wind, or trust in a bridge.
normalIntro.cn: strong 是手臂上看得见的力量、风里感觉得到的力量，也是桥上可以依靠的力量。

normal.en: She is stronger than she looks.
A strong wind shook the windows.
He has strong opinions about food.
normal.cn: 他对食物有强烈的看法。

normal.en: Cooking is her strong point.
This coffee is too strong for me.
normal.cn: 这咖啡对我来说太浓了。

abstract.en: Strength is quiet until it is needed.
abstract.cn: 力量在需要之前，总是安静的。

abstract.en: A strong wind can move a strong tree.
abstract.cn: 强风能摇动坚固的树。

abstract.en: The strongest thing is often the most patient.
abstract.cn: 最强的东西，往往最有耐心。

examples.en: He is strong enough to carry the sack of rice.
examples.cn: 他很强壮，能扛起那袋米。

examples.en: A strong wind blew all night.
examples.cn: 强风吹了一整夜。

examples.en: The bridge is strong enough for trucks.
examples.cn: 这座桥足够坚固，能承受卡车。

dict_mnemonic.text: strong 的核心是「有力」；人有力量是强壮，风有力量是强烈，桥有力量是坚固，咖啡有力量是浓。

root: 来自古英语 strang（强大的），属日耳曼语词，与 strength、strengthen 同源；由身体的力量，扩展到风、味道、情感等强度，再指结构的坚固。

sensesIntro.en: Strong is power in a body, force in wind or taste, and firmness in a structure.
sensesIntro.cn: strong 是身体的力量、风与味道的强度，以及结构的坚固。

core.en: A rope held tight without shaking.
core.cn: 一根被拉紧却毫不抖动的绳。

branches.en: A worker lifts a heavy sack.
branches.cn: 工人扛起沉重的麻袋。

branches.en: Branches bend in a gale.
branches.cn: 树枝在狂风中弯下。

branches.en: A bridge carries trucks daily.
branches.cn: 桥每天承载卡车。

branches.en: A strong body and a strong wind meet.
branches.cn: 强壮的身体遇上强劲的风。

branches.en: What is strong inside resists what is strong outside.
branches.cn: 内在坚固的，才扛得住外在强大的。

intro.en: Strong takes comparison and builds noun, adverb, and verb forms.
intro.cn: strong 有比较级，并构成名词、副词与动词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: He is the strongest of all.
items.exampleCN: 他是所有人中最强壮的。

definition_en: in a powerful way, with firm feeling, or in a solid manner
core_image: 一只手重重拍在桌上，把话说得毫不含糊
scene: 我强烈建议你早点出发。I strongly recommend that you leave early.
sceneCN: 这里 strongly 是「强烈地」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我强烈建议你早点出发。

senses.title: With firm feeling
senses.definition: in a firm and powerful way, as of opinion
senses.definitionCN: 以坚定有力的方式，如表达看法
senses.example: I strongly recommend that you leave early.
senses.exampleCN: 我强烈建议你早点出发。
senses.why: This is force in a statement.
senses.whyCN: 这是话语里的力度。

senses.title: In a solid way
senses.definition: in a solid or powerful physical way
senses.definitionCN: 以坚固或有力的物理方式
senses.example: The house is strongly built.
senses.exampleCN: 这房子建得很坚固。
senses.why: The same force now shows in structure.
senses.whyCN: 同样的力量此时体现在结构上。

intro.en: Strongly is strong plus the adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: strongly 由 strong 加副词后缀 -ly 构成。

items.en: Strang meant powerful.
items.cn: strang 意为强大的。

items.en: Strong kept the sense of force.
items.cn: 中古英语 strong 仍指力量。

items.en: Strongly described powerful action.
items.cn: strongly 描写有力的动作。

items.en: It came to mark firm opinions.
items.cn: 它开始标示坚定的看法。

items.en: It also described solid construction.
items.cn: 也用来形容坚固的建造。

note.en: Strongly is compared with look-alike words and with words for firmness.
note.cn: 把 strongly 与形近词以及表示坚定的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Strongly puts the weight of a strong word behind an action.
normalIntro.cn: strongly 把一个「强」字的重量压在动作后面。

normal.en: I strongly disagree with that.
She is strongly influenced by her teacher.
The bridge is strongly built.
He strongly believes in honesty.
They strongly supported the plan.
normal.cn: 他们大力支持这个计划。

abstract.en: A strongly held belief can steady a shaking day.
abstract.cn: 一个坚定的信念，能稳住摇晃的一天。

abstract.en: To say strongly is to put your weight behind a word.
abstract.cn: 说得强烈，就是把你的分量压在话上。

abstract.en: Built strongly, a thing can outlast its builder.
abstract.cn: 建得坚固，东西能比建造者活得更久。

examples.en: I strongly recommend that you leave early.
examples.cn: 我强烈建议你早点出发。

examples.en: The house is strongly built.
examples.cn: 这房子建得很坚固。

examples.en: She strongly believes in honesty.
examples.cn: 她坚信诚实。

dict_mnemonic.text: strongly 是 strong 加 -ly；看法有力是强烈地，建造有力是坚固地，核心都是把「强」用在动作上。

root: 由 strong（强壮的、有力的）加副词后缀 -ly 构成；strong 来自古英语 strang，因此 strongly 表示以强有力的方式，可用于意见、支持与建造。

sensesIntro.en: Strongly marks force in an opinion or solidity in a structure.
sensesIntro.cn: strongly 标示看法里的力度，或结构上的坚固。

core.en: A hand pressing a point home.
core.cn: 一只手把重点按实。

branches.en: A speaker repeats one clear word.
branches.cn: 发言者重复一个明确的词。

branches.en: A wall stands against the wind.
branches.cn: 一堵墙迎着风立着。

branches.en: A friend gives firm support.
branches.cn: 朋友给出坚定的支持。

branches.en: Strong words and strong walls both resist pressure.
branches.cn: 有力的话与坚固的墙，都抵得住压力。

branches.en: What is strongly made needs less repair.
branches.cn: 造得坚固的东西，需要修补得更少。

intro.en: Strongly is built from strong and adds no further endings.
intro.cn: strongly 由 strong 构成，本身不再加词尾。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.exampleCN: 我们强烈建议早点预订。

definition_en: the way parts are arranged and joined, an organized system, or to arrange something in a planned way
core_image: 一座建筑的梁柱彼此咬合，撑起整体形状
scene: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。The structure of the bridge is very solid.
sceneCN: 这里 structure 是「结构」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这座桥的结构非常坚固。

senses.title: How parts are joined
senses.definition: the way the parts of something are arranged and joined
senses.definitionCN: 事物各部分排列与连接的方式
senses.example: The structure of the bridge is very solid.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
senses.why: This is the shape held by parts.
senses.whyCN: 这是各部分撑起来的形状。

senses.title: An organized system
senses.definition: a system of parts that work together, as in society
senses.definitionCN: 各部分协同运作的体系，如社会
senses.example: The village has a simple social structure.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村子有简单的社会结构。
senses.why: Buildings and societies are both built.
senses.whyCN: 建筑与社会都是「搭」起来的。

senses.title: Arrange on purpose
senses.definition: to arrange something in a planned way
senses.definitionCN: 有计划地安排某事物
senses.example: She structured the report around three questions.
senses.exampleCN: 她围绕三个问题来组织这份报告。
senses.why: The noun becomes the act of building it.
senses.whyCN: 名词在这里变成了搭建的动作。

intro.en: Structure comes from Latin structura, a fitting together.
intro.cn: structure 来自拉丁语 structura，意为拼合、建造。

items.en: Structura meant building or arrangement.
items.cn: structura 意为建造或排列。

items.en: Struere meant to pile up or build.
items.cn: struere 意为堆起或建造。

items.en: Structure named a building's frame.
items.cn: 中古英语 structure 指建筑的骨架。

items.en: It described the parts of a whole.
items.cn: 它开始描述整体的各部分。

items.en: It also became a verb meaning to arrange.
items.cn: 它也变成动词，表示安排组织。

note.en: Structure is compared with look-alike words and with words for frameworks.
note.cn: 把 structure 与形近词以及表示框架的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Structure is the order that holds parts together.
normalIntro.cn: structure 是把各部分拢在一起的那份秩序。

normal.en: The structure of the cell is simple.
normal.cn: 这个细胞的结构很简单。

normal.en: Social structure shapes daily life.
normal.cn: 社会结构塑造着日常生活。

normal.en: Check the sentence structure again.
They restructured the company.
She structured her speech clearly.
normal.cn: 她把演讲组织得很清楚。

abstract.en: Structure is a promise that parts will meet.
abstract.cn: 结构，是各部分终会相遇的承诺。

abstract.en: Remove one beam and the whole shape changes.
abstract.cn: 抽掉一根梁，整个形状就变了。

abstract.en: We build structures, and structures build us.
abstract.cn: 我们建造结构，结构也塑造我们。

examples.en: The structure of the bridge is very solid.
examples.cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。

examples.en: The village has a simple social structure.
examples.cn: 这个村子有简单的社会结构。

examples.en: She structured the report around three questions.
examples.cn: 她围绕三个问题来组织这份报告。

dict_mnemonic.text: structure 来自「建造」；梁柱怎么搭是结构，人与人的位置怎么排是体系，把事情按顺序搭好就是构建。

root: 来自拉丁语 structura（建造、拼合），源于 struere（堆起、建造）；由建筑的骨架，引申为事物各部分的组织方式，再扩大到社会体系与动词「构建」。

sensesIntro.en: Structure is how parts fit, a system of parts, or the act of arranging them.
sensesIntro.cn: structure 是各部分如何拼合、由部分组成的体系，或把部分安排好的动作。

core.en: Beams meeting at a firm joint.
core.cn: 梁木在牢固的接点相遇。

branches.en: A bridge holds its shape.
branches.cn: 桥保持着形状。

branches.en: A village arranges its roles.
branches.cn: 村子安排着各自的角色。

branches.en: A writer orders three points.
branches.cn: 作者排出三个要点。

branches.en: A frame of wood and a frame of roles both hold.
branches.cn: 木头的框架与角色的框架，都能撑住。

branches.en: To structure is to choose an order.
branches.cn: 构建，就是选择一种顺序。

intro.en: Structure takes verb endings and builds adjective and verb forms.
intro.cn: structure 加动词词尾，并构成形容词与动词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is struere, to build, giving structura.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 struere（建造），名词为 structura。

definition_en: to fight hard against difficulty, or a hard fight or effort
core_image: 一个人在水里拼命划动双臂，向岸边靠近
scene: 他在水里挣扎着游向岸边。He struggled through the water toward the shore.
sceneCN: 这里 struggle 是「挣扎」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他在水里挣扎着游向岸边。

senses.title: Fight against difficulty
senses.definition: to use great effort against something difficult or dangerous
senses.definitionCN: 为对抗困难或危险而拼尽全力
senses.example: He struggled through the water toward the shore.
senses.exampleCN: 他在水里挣扎着游向岸边。
senses.why: This is effort against a force.
senses.whyCN: 这是与一股力量对抗所花的力气。

senses.title: A hard fight
senses.definition: a difficult fight or a long effort
senses.definitionCN: 艰难的斗争或长期的努力
senses.example: Losing the job was a real struggle for her.
senses.exampleCN: 失去工作对她来说是一段真正的艰难。
senses.why: The verb becomes the thing endured.
senses.whyCN: 动词在这里变成了所承受的事情。

senses.title: Have trouble doing
senses.definition: to find something very difficult to do
senses.definitionCN: 觉得某事非常难做
senses.example: He struggles with math.
senses.exampleCN: 他学数学很吃力。
senses.why: The fight is now with a task.
senses.whyCN: 这时的对手变成了一项任务。

intro.en: Struggle comes from Middle English strogelen, to fight hard.
intro.cn: struggle 来自中古英语 strogelen，意为奋力搏斗。

items.en: The word's exact source is not certain.
items.cn: 这个词的确切来源并不确定。

items.en: Strogelen meant to fight or strive.
items.cn: strogelen 意为搏斗或奋力。

items.en: Struggle described effort against danger.
items.cn: struggle 描写与危险对抗的努力。

items.en: It also named a long hard effort.
items.cn: 它也指长期艰苦的努力。

items.en: Struggle with came to mean having trouble.
items.cn: struggle with 引申为做某事很吃力。

note.en: Struggle is compared with look-alike words and with words for fighting hard.
note.cn: 把 struggle 与形近词以及表示奋力抗争的词作比较。

entries.definition: to fight a long hard fight

normalIntro.en: Struggle is effort that meets resistance and keeps going.
normalIntro.cn: struggle 是遇上阻力却仍继续的用力。

normal.en: She struggled to open the door.
Many families struggle with high rents.
normal.cn: 许多家庭在高房租下艰难生活。

normal.en: They struggled against the strong wind.
It was a long struggle for equality.
normal.cn: 那是为平等进行的长期斗争。

normal.en: He struggles with the new language.
normal.cn: 他学这门新语言很吃力。

abstract.en: A struggle is a door that does not open by itself.
abstract.cn: 挣扎，是一扇不会自己打开的门。

abstract.en: What resists you also teaches you.
abstract.cn: 让你受阻的东西，也在教你。

abstract.en: Small daily struggles build quiet strength.
abstract.cn: 每天的小挣扎，垒出安静的力量。

examples.en: He struggled through the water toward the shore.
examples.cn: 他在水里挣扎着游向岸边。

examples.en: Losing the job was a real struggle for her.
examples.cn: 失去工作对她来说是一段真正的艰难。

examples.en: He struggles with math.
examples.cn: 他学数学很吃力。

dict_mnemonic.text: struggle 的核心是「对抗着用力」；在水里对抗是挣扎，对命运长期用力是奋斗，面对难题吃力就是 struggle with。

root: 来自中古英语 strogelen（奋力搏斗），确切来源不确定；由身体上的挣扎，引申为长期的奋斗，再用于表示做某事很吃力。

sensesIntro.en: Struggle is effort against danger, a long hard fight, or trouble with a task.
sensesIntro.cn: struggle 是与危险对抗的力气、长期艰苦的斗争，或面对任务时的吃力。

core.en: Arms pushing against deep water.
core.cn: 手臂在深水中拼命划动。

branches.en: A swimmer fights the current.
branches.cn: 游泳者与水流搏斗。

branches.en: A family endures a hard year.
branches.cn: 一家人熬过艰难的一年。

branches.en: A student stares at a hard problem.
branches.cn: 学生盯着一道难题。

branches.en: One hard hour becomes a long fight.
branches.cn: 一个艰难的钟头，成了一场长久的斗争。

branches.en: What is hard to learn is also worth learning.
branches.cn: 难学的东西，也值得学。

intro.en: Struggle takes verb endings and builds adjective and noun forms.
intro.cn: struggle 加动词词尾，并构成形容词与名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the origin is uncertain but Germanic in shape.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，来源不确定，但形态属日耳曼语。

items.exampleCN: 那家艰难度日的店关门了。
每个奋斗者都需要希望。

definition_en: a person who studies at a school or college, or someone who studies a subject seriously
core_image: 一个背着书包、抱着书走进教室的年轻人
scene: 她是本校的学生。She is a student at this school.
sceneCN: 这里 student 是「学生」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她是本校的学生。

senses.title: A person at school
senses.definition: someone who is studying at a school or college
senses.definitionCN: 在学校或大学学习的人
senses.example: She is a student at this school.
senses.exampleCN: 她是本校的学生。
senses.why: This is the everyday school sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最日常的在校学生义项。

senses.title: A serious learner
senses.definition: someone who studies a subject with care and interest
senses.definitionCN: 认真钻研某一主题的人
senses.example: He is a student of ancient history.
senses.exampleCN: 他是研究古代史的学者。
senses.why: The role outlives the classroom.
senses.whyCN: 这个身份可以延续到教室之外。

intro.en: Student comes from Latin studium, eagerness or study.
intro.cn: student 来自拉丁语 studium，意为热忱或钻研。

items.en: Studium meant eager attention.
items.cn: studium 意为热切的专注。

items.en: Estudiant named a person who studies.
items.cn: estudiant 指学习的人。

items.en: Student named a learner at a school.
items.cn: 中古英语 student 指学校里的学习者。

items.en: It also named a careful researcher.
items.cn: 它也开始指认真的研究者。

items.en: Student life became a common phrase.
items.cn: student life 成为常用说法。

note.en: Student is compared with look-alike words and with words for learners.
note.cn: 把 student 与形近词以及表示学习者的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: A student is someone whose main work is learning.
normalIntro.cn: student 是把学习当作主要工作的人。

normal.en: The students filled the hall.
She is a college student.
Student life is busy but fun.
He is a student of human nature.
The exchange student arrived today.

abstract.en: Every student is a beginner with a future.
abstract.cn: 每个学生，都是带着未来的初学者。

abstract.en: To stay curious is to stay a student.
abstract.cn: 保持好奇，就一直是学生。

abstract.en: The best students keep asking why.
abstract.cn: 最好的学生一直在问为什么。

examples.en: She is a student at this school.
examples.cn: 她是本校的学生。

examples.en: He is a student of ancient history.
examples.cn: 他是研究古代史的学者。

examples.en: The exchange student arrived today.
examples.cn: 交换生今天到了。

dict_mnemonic.text: student 与 study 同源，核心是「用心钻研的人」；在学校读书的是学生，把某个领域钻研一辈子的是研究者。

root: 来自拉丁语 studium（热忱、钻研），经古法语 estudiant 进入英语；由用心学习的人，引申为对某一领域认真研究的人。

sensesIntro.en: Student names a learner at school, and also a serious student of a subject.
sensesIntro.cn: student 指学校里的学习者，也指认真研究某一主题的人。

core.en: A bag of books on a young shoulder.
core.cn: 年轻肩膀上的一包书。

branches.en: A class begins at eight.
branches.cn: 八点开始上课。

branches.en: A researcher reads old papers.
branches.cn: 研究者翻阅旧论文。

branches.en: A pupil raises a hand.
branches.cn: 小学生举起手。

branches.en: The classroom is the first laboratory.
branches.cn: 教室是第一间实验室。

branches.en: A student of anything never stops asking.
branches.cn: 任何领域的钻研者，都不会停止发问。

intro.en: Student forms a plural and connects to study and studious.
intro.cn: student 有复数，并与 study、studious 相连。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is studium, eager study.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 studium，意为热切的钻研。

definition_en: a room where an artist works, a place where films or programmes are made, or a small flat with one main room

scene: 画家在她的工作室里作画。The painter works in her studio.
sceneCN: 这里 studio 是「工作室」（第 1 个义项）；句意：画家在她的工作室里作画。

senses.title: An artist's room
senses.definition: a room where an artist or photographer works
senses.definitionCN: 艺术家或摄影师工作的房间
senses.example: The painter works in her studio.
senses.exampleCN: 画家在她的工作室里作画。
senses.why: This is a room made for making.
senses.whyCN: 这是一个为创作而设的房间。

senses.title: A production room
senses.definition: a place where films, music, or programmes are recorded
senses.definitionCN: 录制电影、音乐或节目的场所
senses.example: The band recorded the song in a studio.
senses.exampleCN: 乐队在录音棚里录了这首歌。
senses.why: Cameras and microphones need a controlled room.
senses.whyCN: 摄像机和麦克风需要一个可控的房间。

senses.title: A small flat
senses.definition: a small flat with one main room
senses.definitionCN: 只有一个主要房间的小公寓
senses.example: She rents a studio near the station.
senses.exampleCN: 她在车站附近租了一间单间公寓。
senses.why: One room serves for living and working.
senses.whyCN: 一个房间兼作起居与工作。

intro.en: Studio comes from Italian studio, a room for study or art.
intro.cn: studio 来自意大利语 studio，意为学习或创作之室。

items.en: Studium meant eager study.
items.cn: studium 意为热切的钻研。

items.en: Studio named a study or workroom.
items.cn: studio 指书房或工作室。

items.en: Studio named an artist's workroom.

items.en: It moved into film and music production.

note.en: Studio is compared with look-alike words and with words for workrooms.

normalIntro.en: Studio is a room where making happens, from paint to film to living.
normalIntro.cn: studio 是让创作发生的房间，从颜料到电影，再到生活。

normal.en: The artist cleaned her studio.

normal.en: The song was recorded in a studio.
He lives in a small studio.

normal.en: The TV studio was full of lights.

abstract.en: One room can hold both a bed and a beginning.

sensesIntro.en: Studio is an artist's room, a recording room, or a one-room home.

core.en: A bright room with tools laid out.

branches.en: A brush rests beside a canvas.

branches.en: A bed and a desk share one room.

branches.en: A small studio can still hold big work.

senses.title: Learn a subject

senses.definitionCN: 仔细考察某事物以理解它

intro.en: Study comes from Latin studium, eagerness, through Old French.

items.en: Studium meant eager effort.

normalIntro.en: Study is effort turned toward knowledge, and the room that holds it.

normal.en: The study was warm and quiet.

core.en: A lamp, a book, and a page filling with notes.

definition_en: to achieve what you wanted, or to take over from someone

intro.en: Succeed comes from Latin for going up after another.
intro.cn: succeed 来自拉丁语，意为跟在别人之后走上来。
